ch24.note: The mou (亩) is the traditional Chinese unit of land area, about a sixth of an acre (roughly 667 square meters); eight mou is thus something over an acre—a large private plot for a city compound.

Chen Diaoyuan (陈调元, 1886–1943), a warlord-era general who came over to the Nationalists in 1927 and afterward held senior provincial and military-council posts. It was his grand walled estate on Jessfield Road, as Chen relates, that became the dreaded secret-police headquarters known as 'No. 76.'

ch24.anchor: too many for the bamboo to record
ch24.note: The idiom qing zhu nan shu (罄竹难书), 'all the bamboo could not record them': in the days when books were strips of bamboo, a man's crimes so many that stripping every bamboo in the grove would not yield tablets enough to write them down.
